comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: I checked the current `Compression.node.ts` source: the Decompress branch runs inside the per-item loop but calls `getNodeParameter("binaryPropertyName", 0)` (and also reads `outputPrefix` at index 0), while binary data itself is read with the current loop index `i`. The Compress branch already selects the parameter index as `i` for `nodeVersion > 1` and retains `0` for older node versions. That existing version gate looks relevant when evaluating a compatible Decompress fix; the reported binary-field mismatch is directly consistent with the hardcoded index. Source: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/master/packages/nodes-base/nodes/Compression/Compression.node.ts#L309-L324. I verified the source path only; I did not run the reproduction.
